revisions.description: Changed inventory-location filter from a simple OR multi-select to a tri-state filter analogous to player participation. Each added location cycles through any/is/isNot. Multiple is-locations use OR logic; multiple isNot-locations use AND logic; is and isNot combine with AND.
revisions.reason: User clarified the UX should match the player filter in all respects, including tri-state chips.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Resetting filters now sets inventory-location chips to any instead of removing them. Unknown locations (no longer present in the loaded collection) are removed automatically, matching the player-filter cleanup behavior.
revisions.reason: User clarified that Clear should reset location filter states to any, not delete chips, and only obsolete locations should be dropped.
